name: WMBench (GigaWorld-1)
summary: 以真实机器人执行与匹配的模拟回放评测世界模型的动作忠实性、轨迹一致性和闭环策略表现。
summaryEn: A world-model benchmark pairing real robot executions with simulated rollouts to evaluate action fidelity, trajectory consistency and closed-loop policy behavior.
scale: Benchmark rollouts; the 12,980-hour training mixture is not its released size
scaleZh: 评测回放；12,980 小时训练混合数据不是该评测集的公开规模
organizationsZh: GigaAI / CVPR 世界模型赛道
license: See official repository and benchmark terms
licenseZh: 见官方仓库和基准条款
access: Official benchmark/data entry points; complete download not tested
accessZh: 官方评测与数据入口；未实测完整下载
verdict: 以真实机器人执行与匹配的模拟回放评测世界模型的动作忠实性、轨迹一致性和闭环策略表现。
verdictEn: A world-model benchmark pairing real robot executions with simulated rollouts to evaluate action fidelity, trajectory consistency and closed-loop policy behavior.
wmNote: 同时报告多模型、多指标和分布外回放，适合比较预测与控制一致性。
wmNoteEn: Multi-model, multi-metric, and OOD rollouts support comparison of predictive and control consistency.

evidence.sourceTitle: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
evidence.statement: Official WMBench protocol pairs teleoperation and real policy executions with simulated rollouts, measuring trajectory fidelity and closed-loop success correlation. Do not count the entire training mixture as released benchmark data.
